description: A Luhn-valid 16-digit card number, grouped in 4-digit blocks, embeds an Aadhaar-grouped-shaped (4-4-4 digit) substring in its middle 12 digits. CARD must claim the whole 16-digit span before AADHAAR's grouped pattern gets a chance at the embedded substring. A separate, non-overlapping bare 10-digit phone number elsewhere in the same text must still be detected independently -- proving the overlap resolution on the card doesn't suppress unrelated PII elsewhere.
text: Card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was used. Call me at 9876543210 to confirm.
